1.note: The object of "make new" can be the songs or the name.

2.note: Read as "their hope" after Zech 9:5. A second sense, "from the womb", is possible.

3.note: "Lest I make her shame less" (words cannot equal it). An alternative is "lest I be made light by her shame".

4.he: אִלּוּ בְרָאָהּ בְּשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי בְרֵאשִׁית אֱלֹהֵינוּ
4.note: The conditional has no clear main clause. "Alone" is added by the translator.

5.note: Sense: Tamar needed two times the time, and the hand of the master. The term for "instant" needs a check in Yarden's notes.

6.he: לוּלֵי קִוּוּ מַלְאֲכֵי רוּם לִרְאוֹת צַלְמָהּ
6.note: The logic of the conditional is not certain.

7.note: The reason that Beriah is called "the daughter of Gershom" is not known to the translator. Yarden's note is necessary.

8.note: "Dragon's Tail" is the descending lunar node; "rising degree" is the ascendant. These astrological terms are not checked.
